s02052.summary: Naomi nervously waits alone at a candlelit rooftop greenhouse table
Teodor rushes in late with carnations and Naomi helplessly smiles
Naomi raises his last absence, apologizes, and Teodor accepts it
The waiter promises something special and Teodor takes Naomi's hand
Marisol appears in the doorway with a suitcase, freezing the date
The waiter quietly sets down a cake nobody touches

s01493.summary: Nellie tells the neighbors the garden lease expired and developers close it Friday
They weigh a petition, needing two hundred signatures by Friday
Bridget demands Marcus cancel his meeting or leave the garden
Nellie seats Marcus and orders Bridget to apologize or explain
Bridget reveals she waters dead Hendricks's tomatoes every day
Marcus cancels his meeting and claims the south side

s02143.summary: Hortense holds a goat yoga pose while brushing off Clement's worries
Clement insists on visiting and Hortense tells him to bring a carrot

s01944.summary: Vinnie and Lucky wait for Dee as a police radio reports shots
Dee bursts in shouting go, having been shot at in the robbery
Vinnie ditches the radio and they pile into the sedan
The getaway car crawls through the car wash as sirens approach

s00357.summary: Soaked Coach Odette enters the empty locker room and eyes her phone
Odette lets a voicemail from her past self play, warning against quitting
Odette vents about twenty-six years ending in a restructuring letter
Opening her locker, Odette recalls champions and driving shoes to Colorado
Tired Odette hears her recorded self urge her to show up at six
Odette writes 6 AM on the whiteboard, says go, and leaves

s00695.summary: The partners exchange saccharine pleasantries as the intern brings croissants
Kwame and Marguerite thank everyone and praise Phil's impeccable numbers
Sloane announces a culture refresh and Marguerite says Phil's role ends
The intern learns he takes Phil's desk and demands his name be used
Dewey names himself as the builder of their billing system
Dewey drops his lanyard on the tray and quits

s00589.summary: Arlo questions a hidden tall woman who says she's come to collect
She removes her hat, revealing herself as Charlie Marsh's daughter
Gwendolyn accuses Arlo of selling out her father, who died in a ditch
Trevor grabs a satchel and abandons Arlo to Gwendolyn
Gwendolyn shows a revolver as Arlo reaches for the drawer
They toast Charlie with bourbon and she sets the gun down

s00939.summary: Willow sorts old photographs as Esme recounts drowned relatives
Esme produces the tin whistle Willow's mother played and blows a note
Esme plays a crooked tune and Willow hums along until it squeals
Willow sobs in her grandmother's lap, missing her mother; Esme holds her

s00712.summary: Tamar asks the man his name and he refuses to give it
Dispatch identifies him as Desmond Pryce with priors
Tamar presses Desmond, who admits his hands shake
A smell is reported at his storage unit and Desmond won't deny it

s02402.summary: Roche approaches Eleanor in the dining car after twenty-two years
Roche sits uninvited and they trade cool barbs about time
A porter offers coffee and both decline
Roche says he kept the letters; Eleanor says she burned his

s00388.summary: Phillipa bounces on a trampoline preaching psychological safety
Her blazer button pops off and lands in the coffee
Asked for thoughts, Ogden and Tanvi call it buoyant
All three scatter as the trampoline bounces alone

s00339.summary: At the reunion rink Pearl heckles wobbly Roy's skating
Tamika makes Junior lower his hood and Pearl rejects cold casserole
Tamika fixes Liliana's skates while Pearl pats Roy's knee
Junior watches the tenderness and lets his hood fall

s01229.summary: Malhotra questions Drummond and Birgitta about the released container
Drummond insists twenty-six years of piloting means he clicks nothing
Malhotra spots a pencil mark and both rush to claim it
Malhotra reveals the cutter went to inspect a buoy missing since March
Birgitta confesses she released the hold on someone's word
Drummond takes Birgitta's hand and confesses he told her what to click
Malhotra pours them tea before the waiting car takes them

s00881.summary: Cora pays ferryman Amos for a crossing
Sheriff Drummond arrives with battered prisoner Miguel
Cora questions Miguel's injuries and Drummond tells her to mind her business
Amos insists on raft limits, making the sheriff wait
Miguel signals Cora, who steps in to ride with the prisoner
Drummond relents, hangs up his gun belt, and says lead on

s02097.summary: Juno takes an on-air caller who wants to address someone in the room
Rosalie begs to cut the call as Teddy and Juno argue
David apologizes for cowardice and proposes on air
Rosalie laughs and cries, takes the mic, and says ask in person

s00722.summary: Deacon waits with a rifle by a stranded ferry on the salt flat
Birdie rides in on a mule and they exchange guarded greetings
Birdie shares her canteen and sits beside Deacon in silence
Birdie produces a telegram from his sister; Deacon denies having one
Deacon sets down the rifle and they read the telegram together

s02061.summary: Zara announces eleven minutes until the dome's air scrubbers fail
Barnaby rips open the panel and refuses Solomon's help
Zara orders the seeds to the airlock as lights flicker
A masked woman arrives with the fix, revealing Zara's younger face

s01251.summary: Abigail rolls pastry while guiding Rosalie upstairs to her lost hat
Rosalie enters with the hat and pours tea for them
Rosalie raises their mother's prophecy that Abigail stays and she leaves
Rosalie mentions the noon train and Abigail offers apple pie
Rosalie says Abigail was good at being left, wounding her
The sisters peel apples side by side in silence
Rosalie promises to write and Abigail says she will read it

s01674.summary: Rafa's crew preps the cold storage heist and timing
Osei and Liv confirm camera loops and vault access
Lights blaze and Dominik's armed guards surround the crew
Dominik thanks Liv, exposing her betrayal; Beatrix lunges and Yusuf bolts
Rafa asks Liv what she did and she says what she had to

s00315.summary: Vic has the bound Deacon ungagged and questions him
Vic accuses Deacon of selling the list; Deacon denies it
Deacon implicates Anna and tells them to check her laptop
The ring tightens on Anna as footsteps descend the ramp

s00513.summary: Honoria inspects the cheese cave where Monsieur Brisard was found
Solange laments forty years without a murder
Honoria finds old mold and catches Rollo lying about Tuesday
With the lantern lowered, a trail of white powder appears

s01502.summary: Prisoners trade gossip about the mad King in the cold cell
Tobiah is cold, and the adults wrap and dress him gently
Magnus promises a warmer tomorrow from the Almighty, making Tobiah giggle

s02183.summary: Faure runs the night huddle and flags bed eleven's drifting sats
Faure orders more flow and delays the parents until four
Faure admits she shares the parents' fear; calm feels wrong
Bed eleven's alarm begins to sound

s00286.summary: A woman wedged under collapsed concrete breathes carefully
A rescuer reaches Beatrix by radio and promises they're coming
Beatrix almost laughs, then rests her head as dust falls

s00420.summary: Delphine arrives with a covered birdcage at Haskell's fog station
Haskell reports all quiet; the relay says his lamp is out
The tower is dark and the birdcage is found empty
Haskell promises to light it at dawn and signs off
Something descends the stair as Haskell watches without fear

s02173.summary: Soldiers and a monk pass a quiet dawn in the monastery courtyard
Zeke frets about an attack and Pike says they wait
Marsh scolds Zeke's pacing and he sits in mock surrender
Deluca coaxes the Padre's Sunday garlic and they go to cook
Marsh needs transport for four wounded; Pike will ask the Padre
Pike orders Zeke to put down the rifle
A distant bell freezes everyone until Deluca explains it means bread
They go eat and Pike finishes sweeping before following

s01693.summary: Opal folds scarves while an old man waits politely
Opal takes the man's description of a lost gray coat
Opal finds the coat and its initials and goes silent
She learns he is Ambrose Reinhardt, her father, and greets him
Ambrose holds the coat to his chest as the bell rings

s01528.summary: Junior arrives soaked as Polly grips the sink in silence
The coast guard reports Polly's husband's boat sank, him still missing
Polly forces Junior to repeat it, then smashes the stew bowl
Junior kneels and takes her hands; she asks him to light the lamp
Junior climbs into the dark to light the lamp
